summary: Build consumers from pinned installed Rust components

delivery.outcome: Build Python consumers from a hash-pinned Rust component in an installed build dependency without Cargo/rustc or vendored Rust sources. Preserve Cargo mode, metadata/runtime schemas and native ABI; prove actual NL build with failing Rust tool stubs and shared bytes. Independently merge, release/preserve checkout.
nonGoals: Change runtime algorithms/C ABI/dependencies/platform coverage; automatic dependency installation, import donor code, load Rust code during build or infer publisher authenticity.
Support resource-bearing donors, cross-platform/cross-Python dependency-wheel compatibility, arbitrary header mixing, process-wide deduplication or globally shared runtime loading.
Migrate consumers, claim production/build speedup, registry release/deploy or protected policy/Docs adoption changes.

architecture.decision: Keep common python-modules/rust-library/artifact-package/abi-version with exactly one rust-manifest or rust-component descriptor. Descriptor pins installed distribution/version/dotted package/manifest SHA256; resolve through importlib.metadata without donor imports, require RECORD ownership, nonsymlink files, verified manifest/payloads, same platform/library/ABI and no donor resources. Snapshot selected Rust library and headers; prebuilt build never invokes Cargo/rustc, preserves original rustc provenance, rejects local include headers, records additive rust_component provenance and deterministic dependency bytes in source fingerprint. Consumer wheel stays self-contained with private copies, sdist contains consumer sources and pins rather than donor binaries. Source mode unchanged. Extend pinned NL pilot with --prebuilt-rust and build-only failing cargo/rustc stubs, retain separate rlib-client toolchain use outside consumer build.
dataChanges: Additive rust_component provenance for consumed distribution/version/package/manifest/source pins; all required payload verification stays in existing v1/v2 manifest rules.
architecture.rollback: Protected reviewed revert; source mode remains supported. New-mode consumers require a source/hash-pinned feature-aware backend. Preserve old dist, input/provenance/test receipts and all ignored checkout data.

validation.evidence: Reject wrong configuration, missing distribution/version/hash/ownership/platform/library/resources/unsafe payload before compilers; no donor imports, pinned snapshots/fingerprint behavior, actual source-only sdist->wheel without crates/include and failing Cargo/rustc stubs; installed/exported runtime and binary/header identity.

Full suites and final artifact/install/export/hash checks; actual pinned NL three-mode parity/24 original conformance executions, identical donor Rust/header bytes, no Rust invocations during consumer sdist/wheel build; no new performance claim. Canonicalv19 exact source/receipts and own pinned Docs check.
Local/required remote checks, frozen protected approval/merge, verified primary installation, owner CAS release and preserved exact checkout cleanup/audit.
